title: Chemist-aligned retrosynthesis by ensembling diverse inductive bias models
title_zh: 化学家导向的基于多样归纳偏置模型集成的逆合成方法
abstract: Abstract Chemical synthesis remains a bottleneck in the discovery and manufacture of functional small molecules 1–3 . Although artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted synthesis planning has proliferated in recent years, a detailed understanding of its failure modes has not been achieved, and models still struggle with predicting less frequent, yet strategically important reactions, as well as hallucinated, incorrect predictions misaligned with chemists’ expectations 4–12 . Here, we analyse the failure modes of the present-day AI models and propose RetroChimera: a frontier retrosynthesis model, built on two newly developed components with complementary inductive biases, integrated through a new, learning-based ensembling strategy. Through experiments across several orders of magnitude in data scale, we show RetroChimera outperforms leading baselines, demonstrating robustness outside the training data, as well as the ability to learn from very small numbers of examples per reaction class. Using both pairwise and pointwise setups, we find that organic chemists prefer predictions from RetroChimera over published reference reactions and over other AI models. Finally, we demonstrate zero-shot transfer and fine-tuning on internal datasets from two pharmaceutical companies, showing robust generalization under distribution shift. Our work demonstrates the viability of deep learning for accurate synthesis prediction in increasingly challenging regimes.
abstract_zh: 摘要：化学合成仍然是功能性小分子发现与制造中的瓶颈1–3。尽管近年来人工智能（AI）辅助合成规划迅速普及，但对其失效模式的详细理解尚未实现，且模型仍难以预测较少见却具有战略重要性的反应，以及与化学家预期不符的幻觉性、错误预测4–12。在这里，我们分析了当前AI模型的失效模式，并提出了RetroChimera：一种前沿逆合成模型，构建于两个具有互补归纳偏置的新开发组件之上，通过一种新的基于学习的集成策略整合。通过多个数量级数据规模上的实验，我们表明RetroChimera性能优于领先基线，展示了训练数据之外的鲁棒性，以及从每个反应类极少样本中学习的能力。采用成对和逐点两种设置，我们发现有机化学家更偏好RetroChimera的预测结果，而非公开参考反应和其他AI模型。最后，我们在两家制药公司的内部数据集上展示了零样本迁移和微调，显示在分布转移下具有强大的泛化能力。我们的工作证明了深度学习在日益挑战性的场景下进行准确合成预测的可行性。
